name: ikariam-image-cache
description: Makes Ikariam load faster by keeping its graphics on your computer instead of re-downloading them from the game server. The server has no HTTP/2 and no keep-alive, so every image costs a fresh TCP+TLS handshake (~0.79s), and a 24h cache lifetime re-triggers it daily.

scripts.setup: node scripts/discover.mjs && node scripts/scrape-assets.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
